summary: Verified deployment cold-start bug fix and full regression on Sales Performance Hub. Backend: 20/20 pytest passed. Cold-start measurements (after wiping sheet-backed collections + supervisorctl restart backend): backend became reachable in 0.11s, /api/ latency 88ms (<1s SLO), POST /api/auth/dev-login latency 132ms (<2s SLO). Background sync populated daily_records=73, pipeline_deals=9-10, customers=54, payments=21 within ~15s of restart. Manual POST /api/sync returns 200 with stats; unauthenticated call returns 401. All previously-working endpoints (auth/me, dashboard, daily-records, pipeline, customers, payments, PATCH pipeline stage, PATCH reminder, logout) work; RBAC verified (rep sees only own rows, manager sees all). Frontend E2E on mobile viewport (390x844): dev-login → dashboard KPIs render (TODAY, MONTHLY TARGET, 7-DAY TREND, OUTSTANDING, OVERDUE) → CHASE PAYMENTS navigates to Payments tab → REMIND button toggles to REMINDED → profile-button navigates to Profile → SYNC NOW triggers re-sync and displays SYNCED confirmation. Deployment blocker is FIXED.

rca_of_issue: Root cause: FastAPI @app.on_event('startup') was awaiting sync_from_sheets() synchronously, which performs 4 HTTPS GETs to Google Sheets + hundreds of MongoDB inserts before 'Application startup complete' fired. During Atlas migration the daily_records collection is empty so the full sync ran on every cold-start, exceeding the deploy health-check StartToClose timeout. Fix (verified): the sheet sync was wrapped in an inner async function _bg_sync and launched via asyncio.create_task inside on_startup, so startup returns immediately after index creation. Verification: after clearing sheet collections and restarting the backend, /api/ answered in 88ms and dev-login in 132ms, while the background task populated all four collections within ~15s. No regressions detected across 20 backend tests and full E2E frontend flow.
